claims.population: The article says Lafia has 509,300 inhabitants as of the 2021 census; the infobox labels the same figure a 2022 estimate and cites citypopulation.de for the Lafia local government area.
claims.climate: The infobox gives a tropical savanna climate (Aw). The monthly precipitation normal is about 1.6, 4.8, 12.4, 87.2, 157.1, 214.8, 239.1, 309.0, 235.7, 143.6, 5.1 and 0.1 mm from January to December.
claims.market: The article says that during the rule of Mohamman Agwai (1881-1903) the Lafia market became one of the most important in the Benue Valley.
claims.trade: The article calls modern Lafia a collecting point for sesame seeds and soybeans and a trading centre for yams, sorghum, millet and cotton.
claims.craft: The article says that, besides farming, cotton weaving and dyeing are traditionally important activities of the town's inhabitants.
claims.education: The article lists the Federal University of Lafia, Isa Mustapha Agwai I Polytechnic Lafia and the College of Agriculture Lafia among Lafia's institutions.
